verdict: ROAS holding at 5x over 28 days, but the last three days need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.01 for every $1 spent, generating 39 purchases and $7,422.61 in revenue on $1,482.15 in ad spend — a solid 28-day floor. However, the final three days of the period (Sep 11–13) showed a clear mid-funnel stall: only 3 purchases and $273.80 in revenue compared to 6 purchases and $950.98 in the three days prior, on nearly identical spend. The top campaign has been running long enough that creative fatigue is the most likely cause, and new ad creative is being introduced this week to reset performance. Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply in the last seven days, and we're addressing the posting gap now to restore that organic support ahead of next period.
